nodes.label: D0 No Crashes
nodes.rationale: Most important directive; wins every conflict. Safer implementation chosen over faster or prettier.

nodes.label: D1 Optimization
nodes.rationale: Zero heap allocations in hot paths; visuals client-only; sync only on change.

nodes.label: D2 Co-op Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Server decides NPC/world/random outcomes; player projectiles owner-only.

nodes.label: D3 Balance
nodes.rationale: Every combat stat anchored to a same-tier vanilla item within +/-15% eff DPS.

nodes.label: D4 Pixel Art
nodes.rationale: 1x drawn, 2x nearest-neighbor export, palette-locked, top-left light, no mixels.

nodes.label: D5 Visual Proof
nodes.rationale: Animated changes need a GIF from frames or simulation; in-game capture not required.

nodes.label: Vanilla Limits Table
nodes.rationale: Verified by decompiling tModLoader v2026.08.3.0: NewNPC returns 200 dummy, NewProjectile overwrites oldest.

nodes.label: SafeSpawn
nodes.rationale: Refuses instead of overwriting; keeps reserve slots for vanilla (100 projectiles, 20 NPCs).

nodes.label: SafeLog
nodes.rationale: Reports each key at most 3 times to prevent console loops.

nodes.label: SafeGenPass
nodes.rationale: Catches exceptions so world creation continues.

nodes.label: WorldFlagSystem
nodes.rationale: Saves flags by name, never numeric id, so older worlds still load.

nodes.label: CrossMod.TryCall
nodes.rationale: No hard content-mod dependency.

nodes.label: Core/Templates Bases (CogpunkItem/NPC/Projectile/Tile/Wall/Buff)
nodes.rationale: Missing-texture fallback means missing art never blocks loading.

nodes.label: StateMachineNPC
nodes.rationale: Owns ai[0] state and ai[1] timer, seals AI(), recovers from NaN; ChangeState ignored on clients.

nodes.label: BossNPC
nodes.rationale: Scripted death: refuses killing blow, dying state, server finishes with StrikeInstantKill.

nodes.label: Expert-First Balance Rule
nodes.rationale: User directive 2026-10-27: Cogpunk is played on Expert; all numbers are Expert values, Classic half, Master 1.5x.

nodes.label: Attack-Pattern Fairness
nodes.rationale: Telegraph >=30/20/12 ticks by tier; dodgeable; spread targets in co-op; hostile=Ember/Steam, friendly=Brass/Aether.

nodes.label: 4% Base Crit Rule
nodes.rationale: User rule 2026-10-23; Item.crit=0 since Generic supplies 4%.

nodes.label: CinematicCamera
nodes.rationale: Strongest request of the update wins; no request releases the camera.

nodes.label: Boss-Fight Rules
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-26: Defeated card, no natural spawns during fight, biome despawn, art-matched hitboxes.

nodes.label: Core/Content Slice Architecture
nodes.rationale: Chosen after comparing Calamity, Starlight River and Spirit Reforged; Core is engine, Content is feature slices, slices never depend on each other.

nodes.label: Mechanist Class & Steam
nodes.rationale: Steam works like mana (user-set 2026-10-27), replacing the first README's pressure build-up idea.

nodes.label: CogpunkInvasion
nodes.rationale: Re-implements vanilla goblin-army rules line for line from decompiled code.

nodes.label: Junkyard Vanilla Region Replacement
nodes.rationale: Keep vanilla structures out instead of shrinking around them; mirror dungeon, reserve footprint, wrap Shimmer pass.

nodes.label: Biome Liquid as Restyled Water
nodes.rationale: No ModLiquid in 1.4.4; follows the Calamity Sulphurous Sea pattern.

nodes.label: 1.4.5 Port Readiness
nodes.rationale: Prefer public hooks; IL edits/detours/reflection only as last resort in Core/Hooks.

nodes.label: Seamless Blocks Rule
nodes.rationale: Rusted Scrap went from seam ratio 3.25 to 0.71 under this rule.
